disclosure.blast_radius: src/evolve/containment.ts gains withBoundRoot options (create, identity), an opt-in requireEntryIdentity option on createFileHere/appendFileHere, reason/subject tags on its refusals, the replaceFileAtomicallyHere primitive (returning the written inode identity), and - for the round-1 cure - boundIdentityHere, ascendHere (leave the deepest bound directory for its verified parent through `..`), WrittenFile and revertWrittenFile (walk back to a written file by identity alone and unlink or restore it only while still this bind's inode holding exactly its bytes); the evolve callers (write-once, append-only, proposals, upstream, layout, validate) pass no options, call none of the new primitives and keep their reviewed behaviour. The movedRefusal message now also names "removed" among the observed relocations. Round-2 cure: openRootDirectory maps ENOENT (and the chdir into the opened root maps ENOENT/ENOTDIR) to the tagged relocation refusal, so a root vanishing during binding is refused by name on both surfaces instead of surfacing a raw errno; revertWrittenFile re-checks the entry identity (and the exact bytes) immediately before the restoration truncate, as the removal branch already did; no other behaviour changed.
disclosure.claims: Enforced: AC-1 and AC-3 outcomes exactly as stated in the src/backfill.ts docstring and BACKFILL_HELP; the help text, the faults comment, the src/evolve/errors.ts and src/evolve/containment.ts docstrings and the FSC-C-01 test commentary each state the ADR-0013 (c) residual with its qualifications (not required to detect or defeat; best-effort controls, not guarantees, not single kernel operations). Declared residual (ADR-0013 (c)): a relocation of a write directory that takes effect only inside the interval between the run's final verification and its kernel write, and that is undone again before the run next verifies, is not observed; the run is not required to detect or defeat that interval; the removals and restorations of AC-1 are best-effort controls, not guarantees, and are not claimed to be single kernel operations. ADR-0013 is not edited. The "deferred" wording of the prior todo legs and docstrings (the residual presented as deferred to the ADR-0013 review) no longer appears under src/ or test/. Pre-existing text disclosed, not written by this goal: the test name at test/evolve-layout.test.ts:403 is phrased as an absolute about writes through a symlinked evolve/ and is an unchanged (a)-class regression case in a scope file this goal does not modify (disclosed, not rewritten); the ACH-C-04 criterion quoted in the test/backfill.test.ts header is that goal's registered wording and is annotated, not repeated as a claim.
disclosure.codes: Exactly two observable result codes added: path_relocated and root_not_canonical. The 21 code: literals present at base (invalid, inventory_invalid, inventory_refused, inventory_unattributable, ledger_append_failed, path_changed, path_multiply_linked, path_not_directory, path_not_regular_file, path_symlinked, plan_in_flight, policy_unsupported, policy_v2_differs, root_missing, root_not_directory, root_symlinked, template_missing, template_unresolved_token, template_unsupported, unavailable, unreachable) remain with their meanings; path_changed is now raised when the ledger entry stops naming the opened descriptor before the write (its base meaning), through the opt-in requireEntryIdentity option of the containment primitives. The five evolve refusal kinds are unchanged; containment refusals additionally carry an optional reason/subject discriminator (src/evolve/errors.ts) that backfill maps without matching message text.
disclosure.component_mapping: A validated component observed moved, replaced, removed or turned into a symlink after its identity was recorded - the root chain (recorded by inspectRoot) and the entered .ai, .ai/policies or .ai/drift directories - is path_relocated naming the component. A symlink or non-directory found at descent, before that component identity is recorded (the pathname pre-walk validates type, not identity), keeps the existing (a)-class codes path_symlinked / path_not_directory, consistent with the inventory-time invalidation fixture.
disclosure.result_rule: result is derived from this run's policy-write state: after a ledger-step refusal the run observes by lstat whether the root, .ai and .ai/policies are still the recorded directories and the policy entry is still the inode this run wrote; if so the report is failed (this run's policy write stands at the verified path and the ledger step refused), otherwise this run's write, if any, is reverted while still identifiably its own and the report is refused; a no-op run reports refused on any ledger-step refusal. The refusal's own audit line is still ledgered through a separate bind of the verified root (base semantics for refusals that reach the decision stage): a replaced .ai inside an intact root therefore receives that single line and nothing else (T2e), a replaced or missing root receives nothing (T2b, T7), and a failure to ledger is reported on stderr.
disclosure.scope_note: All edits are inside the six scope paths: src/backfill.ts, src/evolve/containment.ts, src/evolve/errors.ts, test/backfill.test.ts and this file; test/evolve-layout.test.ts is in scope but unchanged (its 38 cases are the regression battery and pass with unchanged assertions). .ai/ci/local-ci.json pins none of the scope paths and is untouched.
disclosure.tdd: legacy-safe (published sidecar: coverage unknown, legacy_safe_tdd true; no percentage invented). Characterization: the two deferred todo legs and the 38 evolve-layout cases. Red leg: the fixtures were written first and run against the base implementation with one identical command; T1-T7 (T3b included) fail there behaviourally - T1, T3, T3b: exit 0 and result written with the policy landed in the relocated directory outside the root; T6: exit 0 and result written (the ancestor-of-root symlink adopted by realpath); T2, T4, T5: result failed with code path_symlinked instead of path_relocated and an empty ledger created outside the root; T7: exit 1 with no structured report (an unexpected ENOENT from the pathname rename). Review round 1 of the goal PR (Architect and blind Critic, both REQUEST_CHANGES on one converging in-boundary finding) added T2b-T2f: a shared ancestor of both targets - the root or .ai - relocated at the ledger step after this run's policy write (T2b replaced root and a gone root, T2c v1 restore, T2d competitor bytes on the written inode, T2e replaced .ai) and the result rule for a no-op run (T2f). At base they fail too (T2b-T2e: exit 0 and result written into the replacement root/.ai; T2f: path_symlinked with result failed), and at the round-1 head b6e8fc8eb4b390bd609cb808755ccbb51f961b9c exactly these five fail while every other fixture passes (log sha256 86bf990294987577d1a0f205d0ceab995a2fa729efc55363475a54f0e9af7c9c), reproducing the reviewers' findings. T9 is the ADR-0013 (c) conformance fixture: it passes at base with the same outcome (exit 0, result written, policy inside the root) and is not claimed red. Green: the identical command exits 0 at the final head with all fourteen fixtures passing. Review round 2 (final-round authorization by the coordinator, one bounded cure of exactly the three named items) added T7b (a validated root that vanishes between the caller-chain walk and the root's O_DIRECTORY open, or between that open and the chdir, is a structured path_relocated refusal naming the root; nothing written; the root never recreated) and T2g (the revert restores a replaced v1 policy only while the policy entry still names this run's inode, exactly as the removal branch requires; an inode renamed away under a competitor's file is left as it is). At the round-2 head 389a144046242f20f9036652533fa513c9160857 exactly these two fail (T7b: exit 1 with no structured report; T2g: the renamed inode rewritten to v1) while every other fixture passes (log sha256 6189668ef0de88524413e4d5527496beccb638b270bd01adfd1c88af5b85d227); at base both fail as well (T7b: the bind never happens, so the root is never opened O_DIRECTORY; T2g: exit 0 and result written). Green: the identical command exits 0 at the final head with all sixteen fixtures passing.
